integrity: Each code is reconstructed from the printed appendix polynomials and tails. Before hull computation, exhaustive enumeration reproduces the published minimum distance and minimum-shell count. Gram ranks are computed exactly over \(\mathbb F_2\), nullspaces yield hull bases, and every hull is exhaustively enumerated.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the six parent codes whose quasi-cyclic data are printed in the manuscript; the unspecified \([200,21,77]\) code is excluded. No claim is made that the resulting hull subcodes improve best-known distance tables. The isolated self-orthogonality of the \([184,21,72]\) code may also follow from a complete doubly-even weight distribution if such a distribution is released; the novelty claim is the exact six-code hull profile and hull-subcode parameters.
title: Large Euclidean hulls in six new record binary codes
